# uptimekuma_notification_threema (Resource)

Threema notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Threema notification resource example
# Threema is a secure messaging application with end-to-end encryption
# Used for sending encrypted monitoring alerts

resource "uptimekuma_notification_threema" "example_email" {
  name            = "Threema Email Recipient"
  sender_identity = "YOUR_GATEWAY_ID"
  secret          = "YOUR_API_SECRET" # Sensitive field
  recipient       = "user@example.com"
  recipient_type  = "email"
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_threema" "example_phone" {
  name            = "Threema Phone Recipient"
  sender_identity = "YOUR_GATEWAY_ID"
  secret          = "YOUR_API_SECRET" # Sensitive field
  recipient       = "+41791234567"
  recipient_type  = "phone"
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_threema" "example_identity" {
  name            = "Threema Identity Recipient"
  sender_identity = "YOUR_GATEWAY_ID"
  secret          = "YOUR_API_SECRET" # Sensitive field
  recipient       = "ECHOECHO"
  recipient_type  = "identity"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: secret_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change secret_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_threema" "write_only" {
  name = "Threema with a write-only secret"

  sender_identity = "YOUR_GATEWAY_ID"
  recipient       = "ECHOECHO"
  recipient_type  = "identity"

  secret_wo         = "YOUR_API_SECRET"
  secret_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `recipient` (String) Recipient identifier (ID, phone number, or email address)
- `recipient_type` (String) Type of recipient (identity, phone, or email)
- `sender_identity` (String) Threema Gateway ID for the sender

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Threema API secret for authentication. Stored in state; use `secret_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Threema Gateway API secret, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `secret`; requires `secret_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `secret_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `secret` until the next apply with `secret_wo` set removes it from state.
- `secret_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `secret_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `secret_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
